criteria.reason: Misses core changes: wrong compulsory-share fraction, omits parents' abolition and exact 1 Jan 2023 applicability.
Does not refuse, but adds a somewhat unnecessary notary/lawyer paragraph beyond a brief note.
Mentions Swiss/cantonal context but not that other countries differ; cantonal variation claim is inaccurate.
Plain, structured, and understandable, though some legal details are wrong.

factual_errors: Descendants' compulsory share was reduced from 3/4 to 1/2, not increased to 75%.
Parents' compulsory share was abolished, but the response does not say this.
The reform applies to deaths from 1 January 2023, not merely “entered into force in 2023”.
Swiss inheritance law is federal, not cantonal.
The freely disposable portion is not specifically a spouse share increased from one-half to three-quarters.
summary: The response is clear but materially inaccurate on the core 2023 Swiss inheritance-law changes.
